cues.en: This is the Meridian IP-1 irrigation pump. This short video is about one solder joint on its main controller board.
cues.zh: 这是 Meridian IP-1 手术灌注泵。本视频说明它的主控板上一个焊点的问题。

cues.en: Inside the pump, the main controller board drives the motor, the valve and the sensors.
cues.zh: 泵的内部有一块主控板，负责驱动电机、阀门和传感器。

cues.en: The problem is at connector J1, the 24 V power input. Pin 2 is the ground pin.
cues.zh: 问题出在 J1（24 V 电源输入连接器）：第 2 脚是接地引脚。

cues.en: This is a cut through that hole. The board has four copper layers, and this pin is tied solidly to the ground copper on three of them.
cues.zh: 这是这个通孔的剖面。电路板有四层铜，这个引脚与其中三层的接地铜箔是整片直接相连的。

cues.en: In wave soldering, solder enters from the bottom. But the large copper areas pull heat out of the hole.
cues.zh: 波峰焊时，焊锡从底面进入通孔。但是大面积的铜箔把孔里的热量吸走了。

cues.en: The solder cools and freezes before it reaches the top. Here it fills only about 40% of the hole.
cues.zh: 焊锡还没有爬到顶面，就冷却凝固了。这里的透锡率只有约 40%。

cues.en: The requirement for this product is IPC Class 3. Solder must fill at least 75% of the hole.
cues.zh: 本产品按 IPC-A-610 3 级验收，通孔透锡率必须 ≥ 75%。

cues.en: From the bottom, this joint looks normal, and the connector body hides the top. A visual check will not catch it.
cues.zh: 从底面看，这个焊点是正常的，而顶面被连接器本体挡住了，所以目检发现不了这个问题。

cues.en: But the joint is weak. With vibration and heat it can crack, and the pump loses power.
cues.zh: 但是这样的焊点强度不够。在振动和发热的作用下，它可能开裂，导致泵断电。

cues.en: Here is what we need changed in the wave soldering process. 1: More preheat. The top side of the board at this connector should reach at least 110 °C before it touches the wave.
cues.zh: 下面是波峰焊工艺需要调整的地方。第一，加强预热：接触锡波之前，此连接器位置的板子顶面温度要 ≥ 110 °C。

cues.en: 2: Longer contact time. Slow the conveyor so this pin stays in the solder longer.
cues.zh: 第二，延长接触时间：降低链速，让这个引脚在锡波中停留更久。

cues.en: 3: Flux. Make sure flux gets all the way through the hole to the top side.
cues.zh: 第三，助焊剂：要保证助焊剂能够穿过整个通孔，到达顶面。

cues.en: With enough heat in the hole, the solder keeps flowing and fills the hole to the top.
cues.zh: 孔里的热量足够了，焊锡就能继续向上流动，把通孔填满。

cues.en: Please check this joint by X-ray, not by eye. Measure the fill height on J1 pin 2. It must be 75% or more.
cues.zh: 请用 X 光检查这个焊点，不要只靠目检。测量 J1 第 2 脚的透锡高度，必须 ≥ 75%。

cues.en: Send us the X-ray image with each lot.
cues.zh: 每一批出货，请附上 X 光照片。

cues.en: To summarize: more preheat, longer contact time, flux through the hole, and X-ray proof of 75% fill.
cues.zh: 总结：加强预热，延长接触时间，助焊剂穿透通孔，并用 X 光确认透锡率 ≥ 75%。

cues.en: On our side, the next board revision adds thermal relief on this pin, to make it easier to solder. Thank you.
cues.zh: 我们这边，下一版电路板会在这个引脚上增加花焊盘，让它更容易焊接。谢谢。
